title: Guilded Maple Maker's Muse

diffuser.notes: Run 30–45 min while sketching or drafting; refresh after a break.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each mist; avoid fabrics and finished wood.

why_it_works: Bright bergamot lifts the mood, fir adds a crisp forest focus, and a whisper of cardamom brings warm, curious momentum.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
